notes.title: Retiring from All Projects.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Alan here.

I’ve recently learned that my cancer has progressed and is now affecting my muscles. I don’t have much time left, and I can’t afford the surgery. Because of that, I’ll be stepping away from all my projects (TGST, RootWorks, ALP, TSP, SSBX, etc.) to take time for myself — to travel and do what I’ve always wanted.

Thanks for everything,
Alan.

notes.title: The Solitude Project Release!
notes.notes:
Finally! The game is now public!! (For 1.99$)

Some explanation about the game story and extra things:

This game was supposed to be a Tech Demo too, for the ALP R / L  Chapter 2. I Gave up on it and started to use it as a complete game. It's a rework + spin-off of ALP, another storyline, another timeline.
And, yeah, it's still in a "BETA". Needing only bug reports and performane reports. If you got any report, post it on #bug-reporting on my discord server.

What is the difference from ALP R / L to TSP?

ALP R / L:
Graphics: Old Lumen Balanced + LQS (LowQualitySamples) RT.
Textures: 1k-4k Textures.
Ray Tracing: Yes, but not fully implemented and Low Quality.
Fully Simulated Realistic Lightning (Path Tracing): Not implemented.

TSP:
Graphics: Newest Lumen Balanced/High + Balanced RT / PsychoRT.
Textures: 2K-8K Textures.
Ray Tracing: Yes. Almost fully implemented, and High Quality / Balanced Quality.
Fully Simulated Realistic Lightning (Path Tracing): Implemented. Try it in the Epic and Psycho graphics quality.
